title: fix(plugin-detail): inline edit hands `dependsOn` fields the staged record (objectui#7190)
body:
Fixes #7190
Clause-②: yes

## What was wrong

A `dependsOn` field edited inline on a record's detail page could never be filled. A lookup declaring `dependsOn: ['region']` rendered `lookup-trigger-gated`, disabled, reading "Select region first", while the `region` it asked for was on screen, filled, in the same edit session. A `select` / multi `select` whose field declares `dependsOn` (options carrying per-option `visibleWhen`) was withheld the same way. Both the details body and the highlights strip were affected. This was measured in the real host and pinned on 2026-09-01 (PR #7207), and re-measured on this branch's base before any change (report comment 5814656189 on the card).

The widgets in `@object-ui/fields` read the record they cascade on from one channel, the `dependentValues` prop their host passes: `LookupField` and `useCascadingOptions` both read `dependentValues ?? {}`, with no context fallback since objectui#7206 (ruling C). `InlineFieldInput`, the one inline editor both record-page surfaces share, passed none.

## The change

Route A of the round-2 claim (card comment 5814689653): the call sites pass the record, the shape the objectui#7206 ruling names.

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineFieldInput.tsx` takes an optional `dependentValues` prop (typed as a Record of string to unknown, the same spelling and shape as the widgets' own prop). It forwards it to the `LookupField` / `UserField` branch, to both `SelectField` branches, and to `FieldEditWidget`, which hands it on to the option widgets it renders.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` passes its `data`. `DetailView` already hands every section the saved record merged with the inline draft.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/HeaderHighlight.tsx` receives the saved record, so it overlays `inline.draft` with the same spread `DetailView` uses and passes that.

The record is the **staged** one. This matches the grid inline editor's `pendingRow ?? row` (objectui#7188) and the form's live watched record. A parent edited in the session re-scopes the child before anything is saved, and clearing the parent re-gates the child.

`Clause-②: yes`: `InlineFieldInputProps` is exported from `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, and gaining an optional member widens the published surface. The seat owes a review-tier contract review before this is enqueued. Hence the `minor` changeset.

Also in this PR:
- The real-host pin `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.lookupDependsOn-7190.test.tsx` flips from the gated reading to the enabled one. It adds the staged-draft cases and the select / multiselect cascade, each at both call sites, each with a live control.
- `.changeset/7190-detail-dependson-lookup-probe.md` is rewritten. Its sentence claiming a host could populate `ctx.data` has been false since objectui#7206. The frontmatter stays empty.
- `.changeset/7190-detail-inline-dependent-values.md` declares `'@object-ui/plugin-detail': minor`.

## Evidence (all at HEAD `cfd1f8c5`, run from the repo root, heavy runs through the shared verify lock)

**Pins first, on the unfixed tree** (test file edited, source unchanged): `Tests 8 failed (8)`.
- The lookup cases failed at `expect(gated).toBeNull()`, because the gated trigger was present.
- The staged cases failed waiting for the declared trigger.
- The option cases got past both control assertions (`select-trigger-tier_any` present, the `tags_any` chips `gold, silver`) and failed at `select-empty-tier` being present.

That last reading is the select cascade's render measurement: it was gated the same way, at both call sites, beside live controls. So the same prop is forwarded to `SelectField`.

**After the change:** `Tests 8 passed (8)`, 4 cases × 2 call sites.
- **Lookup:** the declared lookup is enabled and its query carries `$filter {region: emea}`. The control is enabled.
- **Staged lookup:** clearing `region` in the draft re-gates the lookup ("Select region first"), and the control stays enabled. Staging `apac` unlocks it and it queries `{region: apac}`. `update` is never called.
- **Options:** the declared single select is ungated. The declared multi select offers only `gold`, the region's option. The controls offer both values.
- **Staged options:** staging `apac` re-scopes the multi select to `silver`. Clearing `region` re-gates both declared selects. The controls are unchanged.

**Ablation, one leg per call site, on the committed fix.** Each mutation goes through `ablation-replace` with the anchor count verified and the blob change verified. Each restore is proven by state: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes, `git status --porcelain` is empty. Package resolution is source-aliased in `vitest.config.mts` and no `dist/` was present, so no rebuild legs were needed.

| leg | mutation | predicted | observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | delete `DetailSection`'s `dependentValues={data}` | 4 BODY fail, 4 STRIP pass | `4 failed, 4 passed`, exactly the BODY four |
| B | delete `HeaderHighlight`'s `dependentValues={stagedRecord}` | 4 STRIP fail, 4 BODY pass | `4 failed, 4 passed`, exactly the STRIP four |
| C | `SelectField` forwards (both branches) set to `undefined` | 4 option fail, 4 lookup pass | `4 failed, 4 passed`, exactly the option four |
| D | `HeaderHighlight` passes the saved `data` instead of the draft overlay | 2 STRIP staged fail | `2 failed, 6 passed`, exactly the two STRIP staged cases |

Leg C's first spelling was refused by `ablation-replace` and ran nothing. Its replacement text also occurs at the `BooleanField` branch, so the planted-count check could not move. It was re-run with a distinct replacement, and that run is the one in the table.

**Type-check:** the dependency closure was built first (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...`, 28/28 tasks). Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` were both run, each `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, exit 0, no `error TS`.
- The test program of `tsc --listFiles` names the pin (1 hit; control: 15 sibling `RecordDetailView` tests) and the three edited sources (3).
- Reverse check from the consumer side: a scratch app-shell file passing `dependentValues={42}` was refused with `TS2322: Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'Record...'`, and a record-shaped value was accepted. So app-shell reads the rebuilt declaration. The scratch file was removed and the tree is clean.

**Suites:**
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`: `Test Files 197 passed (197)`, `Tests 1982 passed (1982)`.
- The record-page, lookup and cascade consumers: `Test Files 53 passed (53)`, `Tests 597 passed (597)`. These are all 27 `RecordDetailView*` tests, the fields `LookupField*` / `SelectField*` / `MultiSelectField*` / `UserField*` widget tests, and every test outside plugin-detail that names `InlineFieldInput` / `HeaderHighlight` / `DetailSection`.

**Gates, exit captured before any pipe:**
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK, 8256 files.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: OK, 1 changeset declared.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`: exit 0, report-only. It reports the intended rewrite of `7190-detail-dependson-lookup-probe.md`, declared-at-base nothing / declares-now nothing, which is its case 2.
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`: exit 0. It asked for a read of `8394-record-page-emptiness-authority.md`, which names `DetailSection.tsx`. I read it and it is still true: `hasCellValue` still comes from `./emptiness`.
- `pnpm changeset:check`: OK.
- `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:test-path-roots` and `check:pending-changeset-literals`: all OK.

**Lint, narrowed and declared as a narrowing:** `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `projectService`, no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file. On the 4 touched files (count from `--format json`) there are 0 errors. The three source files have the same warning counts as at the base (39 / 12 / 8). The pin goes from 8 to 11 `no-explicit-any` warnings in its test harness. The repo-wide `turbo run lint` is CI's.

## Round 3 (head `ed7398f1`): the strip value read

- **Pin: 13 cases.** It adds a strip inadmissible case (exactly one prune per field; settles empty), a strip admissible control (zero prunes), a body inadmissible case (exactly one prune per field), and a radio through the `FieldEditWidget` forward at both call sites. A probe counts `onChange(undefined)` prunes and stops forwarding past 20, so a regression reads as a count, not a hung runner.
- **Red first**, sources at `cfd1f8c5`: `1 failed | 12 passed`, `expected 21 to be 1` (the loop, measured and bounded). **Fixed:** `13 passed (13)`.
- **Ablation on `ed7398f1`**, restore proven after every leg:
  - **F**, revert only the strip value read: `1 failed | 12 passed`, exactly the strip inadmissible case.
  - **E**, `FieldEditWidget` forward set to `undefined`: `4 failed | 9 passed`.
  - **A**, delete the `DetailSection` prop: `6 | 7`.
  - **D**, the strip passes saved data: `3 | 10`.
  - **B / C**: `7 | 6`, observed against a prediction of `6 | 7`. The extra failure is the admissible control's readiness wait: with the record withheld, the declared select is gated and renders no trigger.
- **`stagedRecord`** is memoised on `[data, inline?.draft]` as a render-cost hint only. Leg F shows termination does not rest on it.
- **Suites:** plugin-detail `197 passed (197)` files / `1982` tests; the consumer set `54 passed (54)` / `608`. `type-check` exit 0 for plugin-detail and app-shell. All gates exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` is untouched (fenced by objectui#8941); the route does not need it. Nothing in `packages/fields` or `packages/react` moves.
- **Round 3 correction.** Entering inline edit can now stage a cascade prune. A single select or radio whose stored value the current parent no longer offers is emptied, and a multi select or checkboxes keeps only its still-offered values. The next record-level Save carries it: a pruned multi select / checkboxes array is written, while a single select / radio pruned to `undefined` is dropped by a JSON transport, so its stored value survives Save and reappears on refresh (filed as objectui#10291). Cancel discards it (round 4, head `cad44d9f`). This is pinned as exactly one prune per field at both call sites, with an admissible control.
- **Round 3 correction.** The strip now reads each field's own live value from the same staged record it passes as `dependentValues`, so an own draft key wins even when its value is `undefined` (commit `99d6ae96`). The round-2 divergence is gone: at `cfd1f8c5` it closed into an infinite render loop on the highlights strip (contract review `5815969556`).
- A host that renders `InlineFieldInput` directly and omits `dependentValues` keeps today's gated behaviour. That is the visible failure objectui#7206's ruling chose over a context fallback.
